annotations.title: Close, snooze, reopen or assign an Intercom conversation

description: Close, snooze, reopen or assign an Intercom conversation in the brand's shared inbox. action: close | snooze (needs snoozeUntil, a future date-time) | open | assign (assigneeId = a teammate id, or teamId, or assignToMe:true, or unassign:true; ids from list_intercom_teammates). close and assign may carry a message the CUSTOMER sees. Without confirm:true nothing changes and the preview comes back; call again with confirm:true when the user agrees. The new state is read back. Free. Needs Intercom connected (Connectors > Intercom, or connect_connector).

action.description: close, snooze (needs snoozeUntil), open or assign

assignToMe.description: true = assign to the connected teammate

assigneeId.description: teammate id to assign to, from list_intercom_teammates

confirm.description: true once the user agreed to this change

message.description: optional, close or assign only: the customer sees it

snoozeUntil.description: ISO date-time in the future, for snooze

teamId.description: team id to assign to, from list_intercom_teammates

name: manage_intercom_conversation
